faq.q: What is the difference between live resin and live rosin?
faq.a: Both start with flower frozen at harvest. Live resin is extracted with a solvent like butane, then purged; live rosin uses only ice water, heat and pressure. Rosin costs more and is sold by brands like A1 Ducksauce; MFNY and Olio are the main live resin makers in New York.

faq.q: How much concentrate can I buy?
faq.a: New York's possession limit for concentrate is 24 grams, separate from the three-ounce flower limit. Dispensaries sell single grams and occasionally half-grams, so the limit rarely matters in practice.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most concentrates?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown carries one of the biggest cases we track. Gotham Chelsea, Culture House, Buzzy in Brooklyn Heights and Grams in Williamsburg each carry sizable cases too.

faq.q: How long do edibles take to work?
faq.a: Gummies and chocolate typically take 30 minutes to two hours, since THC is absorbed through digestion. Drinks from brands like Layup and Ayrloom use water-soluble THC and many people feel them in 15 to 30 minutes. Start with 5 milligrams or less if you are new.

faq.q: What is the cheapest edible in New York City?
faq.a: In our data, edibles start at {min_price}, and 1906 drop pouches are among the cheapest, at Qube in Midtown, Purple Buds, Verdi Park Slope and Alta. Ayrloom and Layup single-serve drinks are the most common cheap item citywide.

faq.q: Are cannabis drinks sold at every dispensary?
faq.a: Nearly. Ayrloom is carried at almost every shop we track, and most of them stock its single-serve 2:1 drinks. Layup, Tune, Weed Water, High Peaks, Harney Brothers and Cycling Frog are the other common drink brands.

faq.q: What is a dime bag on New York menus?
faq.a: A small 0.7-gram bag of flower, sold by 5 Boro and a few other brands. It is enough for one or two joints and the cheapest way to try a strain before committing to an eighth.

faq.q: How much flower can I buy at once?
faq.a: New York's adult possession limit is three ounces. Most shops sell eighths, quarters and some half-ounces and ounces, and Dank By Definition lists 28-gram bags at some stores. The limit is per person, not per transaction.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the biggest flower selection?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown has one of the biggest flower walls we track. Outside Midtown, Broadway Strains in Washington Heights and the large Sheepshead Bay and Astoria shops have deep walls.

faq.q: How do I use a cannabis tincture?
faq.a: Measure a dose with the dropper, hold it under your tongue for 30 to 60 seconds, then swallow. Onset is usually 15 to 45 minutes, faster than an edible, and the bottle label gives milligrams per dropper so you can start small.

faq.q: Are there CBD-heavy tinctures?
faq.a: Yes. Ayrloom's low-dose everyday drops are 1:3 THC to CBD, and Head & Heal and Papa & Barkley make high-CBD ratios too. These are common choices for people who want minimal intoxication.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most tinctures?
faq.a: ENFLOR in Jackson Heights, Qube in Midtown, Verdi Chelsea and Gotham Chelsea are among the deeper tincture shelves we track.

faq.q: Will a cannabis topical get me high?
faq.a: Lotions, balms and roll-ons generally will not, because THC does not pass through skin into the bloodstream in significant amounts. Transdermal patches are designed to, so check the label if that matters.

faq.q: What is Ayrloom Revive?
faq.a: A 1:1 topical with 1,000 milligrams each of THC and CBD, the most widely stocked topical in the city. Its price before tax depends on the shop.

faq.q: Where can I compare several topicals in one place?
faq.a: Alta on Kenmare Street in SoHo, with the biggest topical shelf we track. Most other licensed shops carry only a few, so Alta is the only place to compare brands side by side.

faq.q: What is the difference between a cartridge and an all-in-one?
faq.a: A cartridge screws onto a separate rechargeable 510-thread battery and can be swapped out. An all-in-one, or disposable, has the battery built in and is discarded when empty. Pod systems like PAX and Plug Play use proprietary pods with their own battery.

faq.q: Which vape brands are made in New York?
faq.a: Jaunty, MFNY, Ayrloom, Florist Farms and Off Hours are New York companies. STIIIZY, Fernway, Select, Heavy Hitters, Rove and Jetty are out-of-state brands produced in New York under license, as the law requires for licensed sale.

faq.a: Qube in Midtown, with the biggest vape menu we track. Twenty8gramz and Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay, Stash Master in Bushwick and The Flowery Upper West Side are the deepest outside Midtown.
